How spreads, slippage and connectivity affect trade execution

From spreads and slippage to connectivity, execution conditions affect every trade.

Research guide4 min readPublished by Surfer Quant
01

Trading costs accumulate

At higher trading frequencies, spreads, commissions and slippage can have a larger effect. Understand whether displayed results include costs and which account type was used.

02

Reliable operations need visibility

Disconnections, terminal failures and delayed data need clear alerts and procedures. Operational support should include health checks, logs, recovery plans and ownership.

03

Test before selecting a deployment

Verify compatibility, contract specifications, trading sessions and resource needs in the actual environment. Generic latency claims cannot replace path-specific measurements.

This is a general guide to strategy evaluation and operations, not individualized investment advice.
